questions.q: Potato cylinders are left in a concentrated sugar solution for an hour. What happens?
options: They gain mass and the cells become turgid.
They lose mass and the cells become flaccid.
They lose mass and the cells burst.
questions.why: Water leaves by osmosis to the lower water potential outside; the wall stops cells bursting.

questions.q: Root hair cells take in nitrate ions from soil where the concentration is lower than inside the cell. Which process is this?
questions.why: Moving ions against a concentration gradient needs active transport, using energy from respiration.

questions.q: Which food test must be heated to give a positive result?
questions.why: Benedict's solution is heated with the sample; reducing sugar gives a brick-red colour.

questions.model: The net movement of water molecules from a region of higher water potential (dilute solution) to a region of lower water potential (concentrated solution), through a partially permeable membrane.
points: higher to lower water potential (dilute to concentrated)
